Reigniting the Verdant Youth Chapter 25: You're Impossible

Li Luo and Ying Chanxi held their umbrellas, walking side by side toward the gate of Jincheng Community.

After some casual conversation, they had already put the incident at the bus stop behind them.

Just as they reached the community entrance, they happened to run into Li Guohong and his wife, who were heading back from the breakfast shop.

"Huh?" Lin Xiuhong paused in surprise and asked, "What are you two doing here?"

"She was taking the bus home from school and didn't bring an umbrella." Li Luo pointed at Ying Chanxi and explained simply, "I went to the station to give her an umbrella and pick her up."

"Well, that's perfect then," Li Guohong said with a nod. "Let's go back and eat together."

With that, the four of them started walking home.

But what Ying Chanxi found strange was that after all four of them reached the fourth floor, Li Luo and his parents all stopped in unison, with no intention of taking out keys to open a door. Instead, all eyes were on her.

This made Ying Chanxi freeze. "Um… aren't we eating at your place?"

"Don't ask so many questions, just open the door first." Li Luo pressed down on her shoulder, facing the door of 402 next door.

So, Ying Chanxi dazedly took out her keys and opened her own front door.

Before she even stepped inside, a rich aroma wafted over from the living room, whetting one's appetite.

Smelling the scent from the kitchen, Ying Chanxi's steps halted. After being nudged into the house by Li Luo, she immediately saw the busy figure in the kitchen.

"Dad! You're back?"

Joy appeared on Ying Chanxi's small face. She quickly changed into her slippers, pattered her way to the kitchen, and threw herself into her father's arms with a thud.

She was, after all, still a 15-year-old girl, and one who didn't get to see her father often. Now that her father had finally returned home for a visit, the usually reserved and polite Ying Chanxi couldn't contain her delight.

Li Luo watched this scene with a grin, expertly pulling two pairs of slippers from the shoe cabinet and tossing them to his parents. He changed into the blue pair himself and walked into the living room.

"Uncle Ying, is all the food heated up?"

"Mhm, there are still two dishes that need a little more heating." Ying Zhicheng patted his daughter's shoulder, a smile also gracing his face. "Alright, alright, we still have guests. Let me heat up a few more dishes."

"Okay." Ying Chanxi left her father's embrace and obediently took out bowls and chopsticks from the cupboard. She placed them one by one on the dining table and invited Li Guohong and Lin Xiuhong to sit down.

A few minutes later, the five of them were sitting in a circle in the living room.

Ying Zhicheng took out a bottle of white liquor from the counter and said to Li Guohong with a laugh, "It's been a long time since we ate together. Have a couple of drinks with me today. No objections from you, Sister-in-law?"

"What objections could she have?" Li Guohong waved his hand dismissively and pointed to his cup. "Fill 'em all up!"

At the side, Lin Xiuhong rolled her eyes, not bothering to comment.

Next to them, Ying Chanxi was also secretly laughing. She whispered quietly in Li Luo's ear, "Uncle Li is always at his most arrogant at times like these."

"My mom is just giving him face," Li Luo whispered back into Ying Chanxi's ear. "If he drinks too much, he'll probably be kneeling on the washboard the next day."

Ying Chanxi giggled happily, then asked, "You knew my dad was back all along, didn't you? You didn't tell me on the way here."

"I wanted it to be a surprise for you," Li Luo said. "Go on, try some. Your dad made all these dishes this afternoon."

Ying Chanxi picked up a piece of cola chicken wing, her expression still a little hesitant.

After all, she was well aware of her own father's culinary skills.

They were really nothing to write home about.

But when she opened her mouth and took a small bite, her eyes instantly lit up. She devoured the whole thing in just a few mouthfuls.

Then she tried some scrambled eggs with tomato and minced pork with eggplant, both of which were her absolute favorite flavors.

"Is your dad's cooking delicious?" Li Luo asked.

"Delicious!" Ying Chanxi nodded repeatedly.

Hearing this, Li Luo nodded in satisfaction. "That's good."

At the dining table, the two youngsters and Lin Xiuhong ate relatively quickly. With one bowl of rice each and plenty of side dishes, their stomachs were soon full.

The two men, however, needed to drink, chat, and boast, a process that wouldn't end in under two hours.

Lin Xiuhong kept them company. Once Li Luo and Ying Chanxi had eaten their fill, she quietly gestured for them to leave the table and go play.

But Li Luo wanted to listen to the adults' conversation, so he stayed put at the table.

Seeing that he wasn't leaving, Ying Chanxi also remained seated, listening to her dad chat with Uncle Li and the others.

"Speaking of which," Ying Zhicheng said as his gaze fell upon Li Luo, "someone came to deliver an admission notice this afternoon. Your family's Li Luo is amazing, getting into Affiliated High School Number One."

"Oh, that." Li Guohong couldn't help but smile with pride. "It's alright, I guess. The kid did so-so, can't compare to your family's Chanxi."

"Being modest, are we? Too modest?" Ying Zhicheng shot him a look, seeing the corners of his mouth about to curl up to the sky. "Penalty drink for you, for not telling me such good news right away."

"Alright, alright." Li Guohong picked up his glass and downed it in one go, then said, "The main thing is, there's no sense of accomplishment telling you. Your Chanxi is right there as a benchmark."

"I'd definitely find those whose kids didn't do as well as Li Luo."

"That's what makes showing off fun."

Ying Zhicheng chuckled. "You even pick and choose who you show off to. Shameless."

"I'm not so bad." Li Guohong put down his glass and pointed at Lin Xiuhong. "You don't know about your sister-in-law. The night we found out, she called all our relatives to invite them to the school-ascension banquet. She didn't let me make a single call, hogging all the glory for herself."

"What are you talking about?" Lin Xiuhong rolled her eyes. "You're tired after a day of work. Can't I help share the burden?"

"Heh heh," Ying Zhicheng chuckled, then raised his glass. "In any case, congratulations to Li Luo. Now he's in the same high school as Chanxi. Let's hope they can get into the same university too, get into Qianjiang University."

"Hear, hear!" Li Guohong slapped the table and raised his glass as well. "Let's drink to that!"

After finishing that topic, Ying Zhicheng suddenly remembered something and couldn't help but ask, "By the way, do you guys know what the housing prices are like over at Qiushan Avenue recently? And Yingbin Road and Zhenxing West Road."

"Hm?" Li Guohong paused for a moment, then said, "They've been falling for the past six months, right? The trend doesn't look too good, but..."

"But what?" Ying Zhicheng asked.

"Your sister-in-law and I talked it over a while back and bought a secondhand apartment from my young uncle. It's near Zhenxing West Road. We got it for a little over 10,000 per unit."

"Oh?" Ying Zhicheng hadn't expected this and pressed on, "Didn't you say the prices were falling? Why did you guys buy a place at a time like this?"

"Ah... that's a bit complicated to explain." Li Guohong shook his head and laughed, then explained, "First, my young uncle's asking price was really low since he was in a hurry to sell, and his place was already fully furnished and decorated. We could move in right away."

"Second is because of Li Luo, this kid. He really worked hard for his high school entrance exams and got into Affiliated High School Number One."

"This apartment is right next to the school, so I was thinking, once school starts for Li Luo, he can just live there. It'll be convenient for him to get to and from school."

"As for the third reason... I've heard that the property prices over there might rise in the future!"

"They'll rise?" Ying Zhicheng raised his eyebrows, a look of surprise on his face.

"I'm just saying, don't take it too seriously," Li Guohong said quickly. "Actually, it's something Li Luo heard from a classmate of his."

"That classmate comes from a pretty well-off family. His dad works on the inside, so he probably has some connections."

"It seems he found out that the subway terminus at Yinjiang District's South Station might be extended by three or four more stops in the future."

"The properties along the subway line are definitely going to increase in value."

"But the news isn't confirmed yet, so nothing's for certain."

Even between brothers, accounts should be kept clear, especially when it came to financial investments. It was best to be explicit.

Li Guohong was also afraid that if he just rambled on, Ying Zhicheng might actually go and buy an apartment.

If the prices didn't rise later, it would inevitably affect their brotherly relationship.

But after hearing what Li Guohong said, Ying Zhicheng's expression became somewhat peculiar. He mulled it over for a moment before saying, "Brother Li, you might have actually made the right move this time."

"Huh?" Li Guohong was taken aback and couldn't help but ask, "What do you mean?"

"I've got some news on my end as well," Ying Zhicheng said. "You know, my company used to have a background in that sector, and I meet a lot of people in my daily life. I hear all sorts of news at dinner parties and in private."

"There are indeed plans to extend the terminus at the South Station, it's just not clear when it will start."

"And it's all still in the draft stage, but based on my information, it's quite likely. That's why I was asking you about the property prices over there."

Li Luo sat at the table, listening to the adults' conversation, and couldn't help but fall into deep thought.

In his previous life, at 15, he definitely wouldn't have been in the mood to listen to them idly chat about things he couldn't understand at all.

He probably would have left the table long ago to go play on the computer in the study, with no memory of any of this.

Moreover, the information Ying Zhicheng had just shared was entirely based on Li Guohong first mentioning the subway line.

It wasn't even certain if Uncle Ying had said those words in his past life.

After all, if he really had, his parents probably wouldn't have poured all their money into Cousin Wei Dongrong's project.

All one could say was that he, a tiny butterfly, had flapped his wings slightly and had already blown the fates of many people around him toward an unknown future.

As for the subway matter, although Ying Zhicheng wasn't 100% certain, Li Luo wasn't worried.

Because at the end of this year, during the G20 summit, it would be confirmed that the country would be the host of the next summit.

After that, Yuhang City successfully secured the spot as the host city.

And in 2015, Yuhang City also successfully won the bid for the Asian Games, securing the right to host in 2022.

Following this, a series of subway expansion plans were confirmed, not just for Yinjiang District, but also for several other remote areas of Yuhang City.

Construction on the subway extension line from Yinjiang District's South Station began at the end of 2015 and was completed and put into operation by early 2017.

Coupled with the Intime City and Times Paradise Walk commercial districts along the line, the surrounding property prices were instantly pushed up to the twenty to thirty thousand range.

So now that Li Luo's family had secured his third granduncle's apartment, all they had to do was wait quietly and slowly pay off the mortgage.

In a few years, the value of this apartment would double or even triple. It was an absolute windfall.

He only regretted not having the capital; otherwise, he would buy three or five apartments, and he would be set for life.

As Li Luo thought this, he harbored no grand ambitions.

He had accomplished nothing by the age of 35 in his previous life. After being reborn, he had no intention of realizing some magnificent blueprint.

As long as he could rely on his foresight of the times to earn enough money for his family to achieve financial freedom, he would be content to enjoy life.

"When does Affiliated High School Number One start?" After they finished talking about the apartment, Lin Xiuhong turned to Li Luo and asked.

"Report to the school on August 24th," Li Luo recalled from the admission notice he'd seen that afternoon. "Then there's a week of military training, and school officially starts on September 1st."

"Then this weekend, your dad and I will go handle the property transfer. Then I'll have your uncle come and help move some of the bedding and stuff over," Lin Xiuhong said. "Chanxi can come along too. You can pick your own rooms."

"Hmm?" Hearing this, Ying Zhicheng suddenly froze and asked, "Chanxi is moving in too?"

"That's right," Li Guohong chimed in. "I forgot to tell you. Since we bought an apartment right next to Affiliated High School Number One, and Chanxi usually has to take the bus to and from school, which is so inconvenient, she can just move in there."

"This..." Ying Zhicheng looked at Li Luo, then at his own daughter, and seeing the look of anticipation in her eyes, he couldn't help but ask, "Just the two of them?"

"There's another girl too," Lin Xiuhong said. "The apartment was being rented out before, and a young girl was renting one of the bedrooms. We didn't terminate the lease. It just so happens they're all students at Affiliated High School Number One, so they can even study together on weekends."

Hearing this, Ying Zhicheng pondered for a moment and didn't refuse further. "Then we're really troubling you, taking such good care of Chanxi."

"What are you saying? We've watched her grow up since she was little. Now you're being a stranger." Li Guohong seized the opportunity to lecture him, finally rapping the table. "Penalty! Have a drink!"

"Alright, alright, my bad. I'll drink."

After confirming her dad had agreed, Ying Chanxi's face lit up with joy. She looked at Li Luo with a beaming smile and winked at him.

Li Luo also took the chance to lean close to Ying Chanxi's ear and ask, "When we move, can you bring the computer from your house? Just say you need it for studying."

"..." Ying Chanxi shot him an exasperated look, but in the end, she just mumbled, "You're impossible."
